name: KMP LSP
description: Adds Kotlin, Java and Swift language support (completion, hover, go-to-definition, references, rename, signature help, inlay hints, semantic highlighting, folding) by running kmp-lsp inside the sandboxed Linux rootfs. kmp-lsp is written in Rust on top of tree-sitter: it starts instantly, needs no JVM and no Gradle import, and stays under 200 MB. A native jar indexer sidecar is installed next to it so library symbols and stdlib docs resolve too.
